title: tui: the issue page as panes
body: A pinned header card with the id in its border and the title inside; the posts in a pane of their own that scrolls; an about pane with filled badges, the dates and the ties as rows the cursor can move through: Tab moves onto them, Enter follows one, Esc comes back the way you came. Beside the posts from 90 columns, stacked under the header below that.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Done as drawn. draw_detail lays out a card (title, id in the border), an about pane (filled badges, dates, ties as rows) and a posts pane; beside each other from 90 columns, stacked below. Page is a stack of ids: Enter on a tie follows, Esc pops, prune() drops ids a reload removed. A TestBackend test renders both layouts and checks where each pane lands; that is the way to see a screen in a test, far better than scraping a pty.
